headline: Easy breeding chain: Pyrin
title: Easy Pyrin Breeding Chain in Palworld | 3 Steps From Easy Pals | Palworld Breeding Guide
video_script: Want Pyrin, a fast fire horse you can ride? Skip the hunt and breed one with this easy three step chain. Step one: breed Sparkit with Vanwyrm to get Chillet. Step two: breed that Chillet with Robinquill to get Dumud. Step three: breed Dumud with Kitsun, and the egg hatches into Pyrin! Every step is checked against Palworld one point zero breeding data. Put each pair on the Breeding Farm with a cake. Which Pal should I chain next? Comment below!
description: Easy 3-step Palworld 1.0 breeding chain to Pyrin: Sparkit + Vanwyrm = Chillet, Chillet + Robinquill = Dumud, Dumud + Kitsun = Pyrin. Each step verified on PalBreedCalc and with the breeding formula from PinDrop's combi ranks.
